criteria.description: Environment targeting has typed fields for default unit key, failure domains, secret scope mode, and default reconcile mode.
Deployment units have typed runtime endpoint, compose directory, namespace, network profile, ownership, and reconcile fields.
Legacy runtime_config fields are read as fallback and normalized into typed fields on writes.
API DTOs expose additive deployment_units, targeting, reconcile_mode, and deployment_unit_id placement fields.
Nostr projections 31961, 31963, 31967, and 31968 carry additive unit placement tags.
Normative deployment documentation describes typed targeting and compatibility semantics.
